# libtommath (vendored)

- Version: 1.3.0 (git tag v1.3.0, commit 95d80fd8229d05dd6cb4ec88bc8d4f5377ff00ef, as recorded
  in the archive's pax header).
- Source: the GitHub archive of the tag,
  https://github.com/libtom/libtommath/archive/refs/tags/v1.3.0.tar.gz (top directory
  `libtommath-1.3.0`). The download step did not record the URL; it is inferred from the
  archive layout and its pax header.
- SHA-256 of the tarball the files were copied from:
  `6d099e93ff00fa9b18346f4bcd97dcc48c3e91286f7e16c4ac5515a7171c3149`
- License: `LICENSE`, "The LibTom license" (the Unlicense text: a public domain dedication with
  a permissive fallback). No conditions.
- Vendored: 2026-10-31, by unit U1 of the C port (DESIGN.md 4.1).

## Files

Untouched copies, no local renames: `LICENSE`, the headers `tommath.h`, `tommath_private.h`,
`tommath_class.h`, `tommath_superclass.h`, `tommath_cutoffs.h`, and 138 of the release's 154
`bn_*.c` files. Left out (random numbers, which use OS RNGs and CryptGenRandom/advapi32 on
Windows; primes; deprecated wrappers; stdio):

    bn_mp_rand.c bn_s_mp_rand_platform.c bn_s_mp_rand_jenkins.c
    bn_mp_prime_fermat.c bn_mp_prime_frobenius_underwood.c bn_mp_prime_is_prime.c
    bn_mp_prime_miller_rabin.c bn_mp_prime_next_prime.c bn_mp_prime_rabin_miller_trials.c
    bn_mp_prime_rand.c bn_mp_prime_strong_lucas_selfridge.c bn_s_mp_prime_is_divisible.c
    bn_prime_tab.c bn_deprecated.c bn_mp_fread.c bn_mp_fwrite.c

Only the files that are built are here. They are compiled as one translation unit by
`third_party/hc_tommath.c`, never on their own.

## Configuration

`third_party/hc_tommath.h` (included by `hc_tommath.c` and by `src/rt/py_int.c`, so the library
and its one user cannot disagree): `MP_32BIT` (28-bit digits everywhere, no `__int128`),
`MP_NO_FILE` (no stdio), `MP_FIXED_CUTOFFS` (no writable globals: without it `bn_cutoffs.c`
defines four exported, writable cutoff ints), then `tommath.h` and a static assertion that
`MP_DIGIT_BIT == 28`. `make check-third-party` verifies that the object has no writable data and
that it links into a shared library with `-Wl,--no-undefined` at the build's optimization level
and at -O0; its imports are `calloc`, `free`, `realloc`, `memcpy`, `memset` (plus the stack
protector's symbols when the compiler adds them).

## Updating

Download the new release, check its license, copy the same set of files (adding any new
`bn_*.c` the kept ones need, which `make check-third-party` reports as undefined references),
regenerate the include list in `hc_tommath.c`, update this file and the checksums below, then run
`make check-third-party test` and `tools/cross_check.sh`.
